entries.title: Critical bond percolation has no infinite clusters on quasi-transitive graphs of exponential growth
entries.statement: Let G be an infinite, connected, locally finite, quasi-transitive graph of exponential volume growth: gr(G)=lim_{r to infinity}|B(o,r)|^(1/r)>1. In independent Bernoulli bond percolation on G at its critical probability p_c(G), there is almost surely no infinite open cluster.
entries.proof_text: Hutchcroft's proof sets kappa_p(n)=inf{P_p(x connected to y):d(x,y)<=n}. Subcritical finite susceptibility, supermultiplicativity of kappa_p, Fekete's lemma and left continuity in p give kappa_{p_c}(n)<=gr(G)^(-n). If there were a unique infinite critical cluster, positive association and quasi-transitivity would bound all two-point connection probabilities uniformly away from zero, contradicting this decay. Prior theorems of Burton-Keane/Gandolfi-Keane-Newman, Benjamini-Lyons-Peres-Schramm and Timar rule out infinitely many infinite critical clusters across the amenable, unimodular nonamenable and nonunimodular cases; Newman-Schulman leaves only zero, one or infinitely many. Thus there are none.
assumptions: G is infinite, connected and locally finite
G is quasi-transitive (finitely many vertex orbits)

source.excerpt: Then G[p_c] has no infinite clusters almost surely.

entries.title: P0043 source status: September 2026 full-scope proof claim
entries.statement: The 2026-09-24 OpenAI mathematics manuscript 'No percolation at criticality on quasi-transitive graphs', Theorem 1.1, publicly claims that iid Bernoulli bond percolation at p_c(G) has no infinite cluster on every infinite connected locally finite quasi-transitive graph G with p_c(G)<1. Its companion Lean comparator names BondGraph.no_percolation_at_criticality and a separate solution module. The comparator challenge contains a placeholder by design; this source-status pointer is not an independent check of the whole proof or imported Lean axioms. Earlier open-problem labels dated 2026-09-07 must be treated as historical.
assumptions: This is a dated claim-status and source pointer, not a theorem promoted by w443
The result concerns bond percolation; general site percolation is not asserted

relations.rationale: The theorem assumes exponential growth in addition to the quasi-transitive critical-bond setting of P0043 and proves that subclass.
The 2026 manuscript explicitly invokes Hutchcroft's exponential-growth theorem before handling subexponential growth.
The 2026 claim has the full P0043 bond scope and supersedes the dated source-says-open label as a status lead, pending independent validation.
